qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Infrastructure concession portfolio (>90% of EBITDA) spanning toll highways, hospitals, and water assets, largely underpinned by availability payments or CPI-indexed tariffs with minimal direct demand risk across Spain, Italy, and Latin America.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5 < 15, REJECT). Spanish infrastructure concessions group pivoting from contracting to P3 concessions (>90% of EBITDA). Heavy project debt load (~€8.8B total debt vs €113M net profit), emerging market exposure in Latin America, and finite concession lifespans requiring continuous competitive re-tendering cap predictable runway.
qualitative.evidence: While concessions generate >90% of EBITDA (€1.35B in 2024) with solid cash conversion, total net debt remains elevated at ~€8.8B against net income of €110-150M. High refinancing sensitivity in an elevated rate environment (Macrotrend 5) combined with Latin American sovereign risk and finite concession durations caps CAP at 5 years.
